groups.comparison: Exact P16 encounter1019, choice72 and receipt36 fully read including tests as source only, never executed. Awareness already names all four independent party/enemy observations; Neither is deliberately filtered from actual interruptions, not an invalid enum state for awareness calculation. Accepted active quest Option owns matching archetype and distance; LocalProblemInfluence optional archetype is legitimate frequency-only influence. Night is observed context predicate versus ActivityTime schedule choice, not mutually exclusive player state. NarrativeBoundaryKind already carries Travel/Rest into distinct entropy domains. in_settlement and another_interruption_pending are independent observed preconditions; both may be true, no reason to replace them with exclusive blocker state. Authored travel/rest trigger flags are independent candidate eligibility, possibly both; owning definition/validation remain untraced here. Deterministic candidate sorting is lexical catalog ID and exact entropy domain/order must be preserved, never derived enum Ord substitute. EncounterChoice already canonical5; retry helper still compares raw string choices at an internal seam, a propagation candidate for other lenses pending actual adapters, not fresh09 enum invention. Retry predicate is immediate equality of encounter, actor, choice and expected revision; no stored success Boolean. Causal habitat bridge absence intentionally hard-excludes impossible archetypes even with quest/problem bonus. Zero weights/no candidates legitimately return None. Counts/minute/index are bounded coordinates, not closed enums; arithmetic extreme API concerns do not establish ordinary failure. Sustainable strategic speed includes intentional fatigue/logistics/terrain rules, distinct from tactical no-extra-fatigue-speed policy.
